1) Remittance label: please add this exact line on invoices in the remit-to section: "Lattice Labs (Redwood Vendor ID: RL-4829)". If you can include PO-{six digit} in the invoice number field that will route automatically.

2) Micro-deposit test: Finance will push two small ACH micro-deposits (random cents) to the account on their side. We’ll ask you to confirm the amounts in the portal to finalize verification. Expect micro-deposits to post within 2 business days after Ben schedules them.

3) Portal test: I attached the vendor_onboarding_form.docx for one final check — please confirm the exact bank routing/account last 4 digits in the portal when you accept the invitation.

4) PO process: Once verified, procurement will create an initial PO (PO-118402) for your onboarding onboarding fee/first invoice — please reference PO-118402 on that invoice. Future POs will follow the same PO-##### format.

Ben — can you schedule the micro-deposits for this vendor? Share expected posting date to the thread so Elena can keep an eye out.
